label: Crew
description: A CrewAI team of agents, each with a role, a goal and a backstory, works through a list of tasks. Only in workflows designed for CrewAI. The tasks run one after another (each sees the earlier answers), or a manager hands them out. The last task's answer is saved in a field. Use {{ state.<field> }} in goals, backstories and tasks. Technical: a CrewAI Crew run with kickoff_async.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The AI model every agent of the crew (and the manager) uses. Plug in an “AI model” block.

inputs.name: tools
inputs.description: Optional. Tools every agent of the crew may use.

outputs.name: next
outputs.description: Where to go when the crew has finished: connect the next step, or Finish.

name.title: Name
name.description: A short name the tasks use to pick this agent, e.g. researcher.

role.title: Role
role.description: What the agent is, e.g. Senior research analyst.

goal.title: Goal
goal.description: What the agent tries to achieve.

backstory.title: Backstory
backstory.description: Optional. Background that shapes how the agent works.

default.name: researcher
default.goal: Find the key facts about {{ state.topic }}

default.name: writer
default.goal: Turn the facts into a short, clear report

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: The work, in order. Each task's answer is passed to the next one.

description.title: Task
description.description: What to do. Insert data with {{ state.<field> }}.

expected_output.title: Expected answer
expected_output.description: What a good answer looks like, e.g. A bullet list of five findings.

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: The name of the agent that does it. Leave empty for the first agent (or, with a manager, for whoever the manager picks).

default.description: List the five most important facts about {{ state.topic }}
Write a short report from the facts

process.title: How the crew works
process.description: sequential: the tasks run in order, each by its agent. hierarchical: a manager (using the same model) hands out the tasks and checks the answers.

output.title: Save the answer in
output.description: The data field that receives the last task's answer.
